title: MINOR IN APPLIED MATHEMATICS - ADMISSION DISCONTINUED Faculty of Science - Mathematics

sections.heading: MINOR IN APPLIED MATHEMATICS - ADMISSION DISCONTINUED
lines: Admission to this module is discontinued effective September 1, 2022. Students currently enrolled in the module will be permitted to graduate upon fulfilment of the module requirements by August 31, 2026.

Completion of first-year requirements, including 0.5 course from Calculus 1000A/B, Calculus 1500A/B, Numerical and Mathematical Methods 1412A/B, the former Applied Mathematics 1412A/B, Calculus 1301A/B, Calculus 1501A/B, Numerical and Mathematical Methods 1414A/B, the former Applied Mathematics 1414A/B. Applied Mathematics 1413 may be substituted for 1.0 Calculus course requirement. Each of these requires a minimum mark of 60%.
Mathematics 1600A/B or Numerical and Mathematical Methods 1411A/B or the former Applied Mathematics 1411A/B, with a mark of at least 60% and completed by the end of Term 1 in Year 2.
Applied Mathematics 1999F/G, while not required, will be useful for students in this module.

2.5 courses from: Applied Mathematics 2811B, Applied Mathematics 2814F/G, Applied Mathematics 3615A/B, Applied Mathematics 3811A/B, Applied Mathematics 3813A/B, Applied Mathematics 3815A/B, Applied Mathematics 3911F/G, Financial Modelling 3817A/B or the former Applied Mathematics 3151A/B, the former Applied Mathematics 3817A/B.
0.5 course: Applied Mathematics 2402A or the former Differential Equations 2402A.
